Mehbooba Mufti Visits Rajouri Flood Victims, Seeks Relief

Former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti visited Rajouri to assess the impact of recent floods. She met with victims and their families to understand their needs. Mufti urged the government to provide immediate relief to those affected by the floods. She also specifically requested a government job for the son of a worker who went missing during the floods.
